name: Draining Bite
description: Bite a hollow in the foe's soul force and pull the loosed measure into the user.

name: Dregs Sense
description: Sift the dregs of a soul with the user's own to learn what is left in it to take.

name: Parched Ward
description: Parch the air before the soul so that a soul strike withers before it arrives.

name: Lank Step
description: Take a lank loose step that slides the user out of the foe's soul-sight.

name: Siphon Burst
description: Loose a burst of siphon-bolts that each draw a bead of soul force from the target.

name: Thread Tear
description: Tear one thread from the weave of the foe's soul and swallow the force that comes with it.

name: Soul Devour
description: Gorge on the foe's soul in a heavy strike and let the drawn force fill the user's own reserve.

name: Famine Blight
description: Spread a field of famine through a group so that every soul within it starves a little.

name: Long Sip
description: Take a long steady sip of the drawn force and let it settle in the user's soul.

name: Slow Bite
description: Bite slowly into the foe's soul so that he feels it only after the force is gone.

name: Lingering Ward
description: Hold a ward that lingers about the soul and eats at whatever touches it.

name: Patient Taste
description: Taste a soul patiently over several breaths to learn its hidden weaknesses.

name: Starved Creep
description: Creep around the foe's soul-sight so that he never feels the user move.

name: Seeping Chain
description: Seep a chain of qi into the foe's soul that holds it and drinks from it.

name: Patient Siphon
description: Hold a siphon on the foe's soul that presses down his will while it feeds.

name: Draught Purge
description: Purge the residue of a drain from an ally's soul by feeding on it before it sets.

name: Long Drain
description: Drain the foe's soul over many breaths while the force flows steadily into the user.

name: Draining Cloud
description: Spread a cloud of hunger that drains every soul it drifts across.

name: Paired Gulp
description: Close two mouths on the foe's soul at once and swallow double the force.

name: Twin Maw
description: Open two maws before the soul so that a soul strike meets a second mouth if it passes the first.

name: Pair Taste
description: Taste two souls at the same time and measure the one against the other.

name: Echo Pace
description: Pace out of the foe's soul-sight and leave a faint echo of the draw in his focus.

name: Double Siphon
description: Run two siphons from two points of the foe's soul so that he cannot close both.

name: Stooping Bite
description: Stoop on the foe's soul from above and bite through his guard to the core.

name: Twin Feeding
description: Feed from two sources at once and pour the drawn force into the user and one ally.

name: Twinned Hunger
description: Bind the foe's soul in two places and feed from both until he is hollow.

name: Pairing Feast
description: Gorge on two groups of foes at once in a wide arc that drains each soul it crosses.

name: Talon Draw
description: Draw force from the foe's soul with a talon of qi that hooks and pulls.

name: Keen Hunger
description: Sharpen the hunger of the soul until it can pick out one soul in a crowd.

name: Feathered Maw
description: Cover the soul with a feathered maw that sheds and eats the force of a strike.

name: Soaring Pace
description: Soar a short way on the lift of drawn soul force to clear the foe's reach.

name: Silent Gulp
description: Gulp down a drawn measure without a sound and let the foe think he is unharmed.

name: Swooping Siphon
description: Swoop a siphon across the foe's focus and carry off a thread of it.

name: Voiceless Stoop
description: Stoop silently on the foe's soul and pierce its guard before he can raise it.

name: Hush Maw
description: Hold a quiet maw before the soul that swallows soul strikes without a ripple.

name: Mute Chain
description: Wrap the foe's soul in a mute chain so that he cannot cry out as it feeds.

name: Plunging Feast
description: Plunge from above with a silent gorge that takes a great share of the foe's soul at once.

name: Hawk Feast
description: Spread a feast of hawks of soul force over a group that strip each soul they cross.

name: Measured Bite
description: Bite once under a sworn measure that takes only what the oath allows.

name: Oath Taste
description: Taste a soul under oath to learn what share of it can be taken without ruin.

name: Pledged Ward
description: Hold a ward pledged to eat only what strikes it and nothing more.

name: Lean Pace
description: Take a lean quick pace on the bearing of the oath to leave the foe behind.

name: Oathbound Siphon
description: Run a siphon sworn to a fixed measure that spoils the foe's technique and then stops.

name: Vow Feast
description: Gorge through the foe's guard to the measure the vow allows and no further.

name: Sworn Feast
description: Feast on the foe's soul to the measure of the oath and pour that share into the user.

name: Oath Famine
description: Spread a famine under oath that takes the same measure from every soul it crosses.

name: Unfilled Maw
description: Hold an unfilled maw before the soul that always has room for another strike.

name: Barren Oath
description: Speak a hollow oath into the foe's soul that spoils his next technique.

name: Vow Bite
description: Bite on a vow that holds the foe's soul still while the force is drawn.

name: Level Sip
description: Sip evenly from the drawn force and keep the user's soul at a steady level.

name: Held Taste
description: Hold the taste of a soul on the tongue of the spirit to track it across the field.

name: Wary Pace
description: Move with a quiet pace that the foe's soul-sight cannot catch.

name: Unfilled Chain
description: Wrap the foe's soul in a chain that feeds on his struggles and is never full.

name: Pledge Siphon
description: Hold a pledged siphon on the foe's will that presses it down while he is fed upon.

name: Hunger Spear
description: Drive an oath-sworn lance of hunger through the guard and drink from the wound.

name: Hunger Purge
description: Purge a binding or a stain from an ally's soul by taking it into the user's own hunger.

name: Unfilled Hunger
description: Unleash the hunger that is never filled upon one foe and press down his will as it feeds.

name: Starving Tempest
description: Raise a tempest of famine over a field that tears at every soul within it.
